text_ru: Аврал на покосе длится уже четыре дня. Можно снять аврал.
meaning: The cut's avral has reached its allowed duration
intent: Name the available relief without promising the shortage ends
keep: Four-day limit; voluntary order; hay lamp only
binding_note: Select only when advice=lift_rush; duration matches hay_avral_days_a_cut=4 in the accepted design

meaning: Label of the existing order to end the cut's avral
intent: Use the registered advice title rather than inventing an operation
keep: Existing zero-valued avral order; not an automatic action
binding_note: Same lift_rush case; omit this duplicate key if UE already reads the registered vocabulary title

text_ru: Сегодня сухой выходной. Можно объявить его рабочим для покоса — за счёт отдыха людей.
meaning: Today's dry day off can become a mowing workday
intent: Name the hay-specific order and its qualitative rest cost
keep: Dry morning; current day; once per calendar month; no free recovery
binding_note: advice=declare_day_working and advice_day=0; do not replace the cargo-specific logistics_late advice

text_ru: Выходной: {date}. Если утром будет сухо, можно объявить его рабочим для покоса — за счёт отдыха людей.
meaning: A future day off may be worked only on its own dry morning
intent: Distinguish advance notice from an order available today
keep: Weather remains conditional; no exact future weather; rest cost; no day-of-month
binding_note: advice=declare_day_working and advice_day!=0; date must be a boss-approved calendar caption for absolute advice_day; not the raw integer or numbered date

text_ru: Луга будут выкошены целиком, но сена всё равно не хватит. После покоса можно сдать часть стада району. Срок: {date}. Уйдут старшие животные; у лошадей — рабочие.
meaning: Grass limits the harvest; the district handover belongs after the cut
intent: Name the deferred alternative without urging a premature handover
keep: Live animals to district; above floors only; old animals and working horses warning; no slaughter
binding_note: advice=reduce_herd and advice_day!=0 in grass-bound cut; date captions absolute advice_day; keep existing immediate reduce_herd text and head-count bindings

text_ru: До первых перебоев с сеном — {days} {days}|plural(one=сутки,few=суток,many=суток,other=суток). До поступления сена нового укоса не хватит {tonnes} т.
meaning: Time to first underfeeding and total shortage expressed as hay-equivalent tonnes
intent: Show the forecast rather than the worst-day head count
keep: days=0 remains zero days; hay not first_short_resource; horizon includes delivery; no promise
binding_note: Replacement metadata required: retain days from days_ahead; remove heads and resource placeholders; add tonnes=short_grams/1000000; decimal locale formatting must not erase a positive shortage

text_ru: Первые перебои с сеном: {date}. До поступления сена нового укоса не хватит {tonnes} т.
meaning: Calendar-caption variant of the same hay forecast
intent: Give a calendar deadline only after the date-caption seam is agreed
keep: Same horizon and shortage as text; no numbered date or inclusive stock-through-date claim
binding_note: date captions current absolute game day plus days_ahead; tonnes=short_grams/1000000; alternative to text not a second simultaneous forecast

text_ru: Покос ещё идёт. Нехватка сена остаётся в прогнозе; дополнительного совета по покосу на сегодня нет.
meaning: A lit forecast may have no currently named cut move
intent: Make the permitted silence legible without implying a runtime failure
keep: Open cut only; no promise of adequate hay; no ban on all other decisions
binding_note: Select only during an open cut when advice is absent; do not replace generic advice.none outside that branch
